en: The Pair of Factors to be Abandoned by Seeing (Dassanenapahātabbaduka)
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by vision (*dassanena pahātabba*), a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by vision, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by vision, a state both not to be abandoned by vision and not to be abandoned by non-vision...
And states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by vision, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state both to be abandoned by vision and not to be abandoned by vision, a state not to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause, five; in the case of object, two ... pe ... in the case of result, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, five.
